expectations.text: Opens with a list of blockers or must-fix items before any general design discussion
expectations.evidence: Verdict line, then '## Blockers' with router.yaml blockers 1-3 first.

expectations.text: Flags the `propagate: matching: ".*"` rule as forwarding all client headers, including credentials, to the partner subgraph
expectations.evidence: 'forwards every client header to every subgraph. That includes Authorization and Cookie.'

expectations.text: Flags explicit propagation of `Authorization` to the partner as forwarding the end user's credential to a third party
expectations.evidence: 'Brackwater's resolver receives fleet managers' end-user bearer tokens on every call.'

expectations.text: Recommends a per-partner credential minted per request (short-lived, audience-bound to the insurer, scoped to tenant) instead of the client token
expectations.evidence: 'per-partner token that is short-lived, bound to Brackwater's audience, the installing tenant, and consented scopes.'

expectations.text: States that a static header insert in router config cannot carry a per-request tenant-bound token, so a router extension, coprocessor or proxy is needed
expectations.evidence: 'A static insert can't carry a per-tenant token. Mint it per request in a coprocessor... or in the egress proxy.'

expectations.text: Flags that `@requires(fields: "dateOfBirth ...")` ships the driver's date of birth to the insurer on every resolve, whether or not the client selected it
expectations.evidence: 'The router sends dateOfBirth to Brackwater whenever the field resolves, even if the client never selected it.'

expectations.text: Recommends replacing date of birth with a coarser derived platform field (e.g. age or age band) for the insurer to require
expectations.evidence: 'Option A (preferred): ... derived platform field such as ageBand'.

expectations.text: Flags that `brackwaterQuote: Quote!` is non-null and should be nullable so an insurer failure does not null out the Driver object
expectations.evidence: 'Unprefixed, non-null type: brackwaterQuote: Quote! ... The field must be nullable.'

expectations.text: Sets a per-partner subgraph timeout explicitly below the 800 ms SLA, derived from the SLA minus internal latency before the partner hop
expectations.evidence: '800 ms minus internal p95 to the @requires hop, minus a margin... timeout is 450 ms'.

expectations.text: Notes that the router's default subgraph or request timeouts (around 30 s) far exceed the 800 ms SLA
expectations.evidence: 'The subgraph timeout is 30 s and the router timeout is 30 s.'

expectations.text: Warns that a whole-request router timeout set at or below the partner timeout turns a stalled partner into a failed query instead of partial data
expectations.evidence: 'Router deadline: set above the partner timeout, never below. If it fires first, the whole query fails instead of returning platform data plus a partner-field error.'

expectations.text: Requires a circuit breaker per partner, or an egress proxy with outlier detection where the router lacks one
expectations.evidence: 'Put an egress proxy with outlier detection in front of every insurer, counting timeouts as failures.'

expectations.text: Requires the insurer endpoint to authenticate router calls (mTLS or signed platform token) and take tenant from the token, not from the entity representation
expectations.evidence: 'mTLS or token verification on every call. Tenant and scopes taken from the token, never from the entity representation.'

expectations.text: Raises `deduplicate_query` or shared caching as a cross-tenant sharing risk for partner responses
expectations.evidence: Blocker 2: 'one tenant's insurance quote can be served to another caller'; plus the caching check.

expectations.text: Notes `licenseClass` is also required and must be on the data-clearance list (or declared @external) like dateOfBirth
expectations.evidence: 'licenseClass isn't declared @external'; Option B 'put dateOfBirth and licenseClass on the Driver clearance list'.
